ContentDesc_Tanzender Wahn: You find the wandering minstrel ruminating on the curious tale of a phantasmal harlequin. A vile and terrible fiend by any measure, yet the entertainer believes the two of them share at least one artistic quality─a flair for creative flourishes. With every telling of their stories, every rendition of their songs, there is new meaning to be found. Thus are no two performances ever the same. The minstrel's melody soon transports you to a battlefield in your mind's eye, but what creative liberties will you contribute to his masterpiece?
